premises.text: Children should learn technology young, but existing tech-teaching toys are inadequate or unsafe for that purpose
premises.evidence_span: these toys that teach children about technology are very dangerous to them. And we want to change it

premises.text: Modular cubes embed motors, sensors, and controllers that kids snap together into robots without wires between cubes
premises.evidence_span: We're embedding different electronics into the cubes. And kids can snap them together and build their own robots

premises.text: Kids program robots via an intuitive drag-and-drop app on phone or tablet without writing code
premises.evidence_span: Kids can program their own robots with a very intuitive programming app on the iPad. Kids don't need to write the code

premises.text: Multiple kit tiers (9/15/25 cubes plus Pro and sensor sets) serve different ages and complexity levels
premises.evidence_span: we created three different robotics kits with the 9, 15, and 25 cubes

premises.text: Launch and distribution via Kickstarter to make robotics electronics accessible to kids, parents, and educators
